 Published Nov. 18, 2026 4:43 a.m. ET share facebook x reddit link Associated Press Texas Southern Tigers (1-4) at San Diego State Aztecs (4-0)
 San Diego; Wednesday, 10 p.m. EST
 BOTTOM LINE: Texas Southern visits San Diego State after Karris Bilal scored 36 points in Texas Southern's 97-92 loss to the UCSD Tritons.
 San Diego State went 22-11 overall last season while going 14-2 at home. The Aztecs averaged 78.2 points per game last season, 34.2 in the paint, 16.2 off of turnovers and 11.6 on fast breaks.
 The Tigers have gone 0-4 away from home. Texas Southern ranks third in the SWAC with 30.4 rebounds per game led by Bencao Vungo averaging 7.4.
